notes.title: The conditions of true ending and DLC hidden ending are simplified
notes.content:
I didn't realize it was almost two years ago, it's been a while since I paid attention to stumble upon so many more negative reviews, I hope this update will help afterwards.

But to be honest, there are still some faults in this game that can't be solved by a patch. For example, too much important information is arranged in the branch line, so it is easy to let only play the main line or only reach a single ending players feel that the story is abrupt or do not understand. If I were to make another game, I would let only the main line and the normal ending of the game is at least a complete story, or simply do a more single-line flow, not to get fragmented narrative.

Some people ask if there is still new DLC? My answer is yes, my new game "Nyaruru Fishy Fight" is set to be the sequel to "Nyakori" DLC, but "Nyaruru Fishy Fight" more should start a brand new story, after all, by then many "Nyaruru Fishy Fight" players have not played "Nyakori", and even if They saw the game news will most likely not to play "Nyakori", because the game is the audience distinction, for a variety of game types, we all have their own preferences, this is normal. So this is a big problem, I had to take everyone in the "Nyaruru Fishy Fight" to review the full "Nyakori" story.

[strike]You may ask didn't they all die at the end of the DLC? [/strike]How can you continue to write? I can only say that some people did die, but some did not. The final episode of Nyakori was so sad, I'm really sorry, so I will definitely write a "heartwarming" happy ending in the new one to apologize to everyone.

notes.title: About our new game
notes.content:
After half a year of preparation, our new game <Nyaruru Fishy Fight> is about to release. This game is a Metroidvania game with exciting battels which required some operating skills. However, the story line is still based on <Nyakori’s rabbit doll>, and the main character are also the same.

The demo version of the game has been released. You are welcome to add it to your wish list!

If you need to know the development progress and the release date of this game, please follow 赤瞳大白猫 on Bilibili or join QQ group 833191551 to get the newest information.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478160/_/

notes.title: DLC difficulty reduction announcement
notes.content:
Based on players feedback, we decided to add automatic saving to the platform skipping game and lower the skipping difficulty.
The pass requirements of some operations are reduced and the time is extended.
We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Nyakori’s Rabbit Doll--DLC is now on sale.
notes.content:
If you experienced a game crash, please restart STEAM or verify integrity of game files.
We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: The DLC will be released at 10pm on August 21, 2020 (PDT).
notes.content: The DLC of Nyakori's rabbit doll will be released at 10pm on August 21, 2020 (PDT). This DLC includes our new story and new game design. If you are interested, please click the link for more information : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1246570

notes.title: We have updated the English version
notes.content:
The previous translation has been replaced, and new English version will also be applied to DLC.

We hope you enjoy this game.

notes.title: The English version of Nyakori's Rabbit Doll will be replaced.
notes.content:
We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the insufficient translation of the game text. There were some issues with the game because we hired a poor translator.

We are planning to replace the translation of Nyakori's Rabbit Doll. The new version is expected to be completed around mid-March.

notes.title: There is only one week left until game releases!
notes.content:
How is everybody going? 

Recently, a new pneumonia caused by uncertain coronavirus prevailed in China. So I can only stay home. When going out, I must wear a mask. Although the virus comes ferociously, the game will be released as scheduled. 

Now our team have submitted the final version to STEAM on January 23rd . And the approval process of game usually lasts less than 5 days. Normally, the game will be released on January 31st as expected. So see you next week!

notes.title: Announcement of release delay
notes.content:
We are so sorry that because production crew hasn’t controlled the progress well in the early stage, it is impossible for us to bring an optimal experience of the game in 27th January 2020.

After a series of careful consideration, we now decide to delay the release date to 31st January 2020 and promise that the production crew will not make such mistake any more!
